model_output:
```sql
WITH viewpoints AS (
  SELECT 
    'Stratton Fire Tower, Stratton, Vermont'::text AS name,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-72.924966, 43.086214), 4326)::geography AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    poi.poi_name || ', ' || poi.addr_city || ', ' || poi.addr_state,
    pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE pois.poi_name ILIKE '%viewpoint%' 
    AND pois.addr_city = 'Stratton' 
    AND pois.addr_state = 'Vermont'
    AND pois.id != 23048 -- exclude the first viewpoint already listed
  LIMIT 2
),
viewpoint_elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    v.name,
    ST_Value(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_PointN(ST_DumpPoints(v.geom::geometry)).geom, 4326), 4326),
      1
    ) AS elevation
  FROM viewpoints v
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, v.geom::geometry)
)
SELECT name, elevation
FROM viewpoint_elevations
ORDER BY elevation ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
